⚔️ Victor killed the Ugly Beast with their party — 9 rounds, 36 taken. Word travels fast. The carcass is out there — haul it home before it rots.
The treeline is quiet. No shapes in the dark.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
🛟 Riley stands up by the fire. "Nobody's saying it, so I will: we need a plan, tonight. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"We can bind the wounds, or go lean, or hunt hard to replace what we lost. Say which — standing here isn't an answer."
"Or we rally," Riley adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)

sayLines.line: Filled 1L (clean — Haven well). 3L carried (3kg). (-10 kcal hauling, 1 tick.) Cistern: 19L left.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 20s says. (Trust too low.)

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Something moves out there — a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something.
Movement — a long gray snake coiled on a sunlit log.
👁 No rattle, no venom — but your hands don't know that yet. It freezes, hoping you'll walk past. Pin it behind the head; it bites only when grabbed.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 8 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 9 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Unfamiliar unknown nuts — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
Journal: Riparian ground. Water means life, and lunch.
The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 4× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
The creek runs fast here — no crossing without a bridge or a swim.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.
Movement — a thick-bodied rattlesnake, chevron bands, the tail a blur of dry sound.
👁 It warns first — the rattle IS the negotiation. Heed it. Pin it behind the head with a forked stick, or take it at range. Never reach.
Unfamiliar unknown berries — into the bag. (Unknowns lump together; sort them at camp.)
Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 3× unknown berries. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
It sits up on its hind legs, hands moving too fast to follow. It's trying to figure out your pack.

Travel 2 tiles to ruin.
— Pre-Burn ruin —
A collapsed barn. Pre-Burn. The wiring is gone — everything is gone — but the stones remember the shape of work.
It followed you. The raccoon with too many fingers is here.
You find a book: "The Night Shift Notebook". a third-shift worker's notebook, written by headlamp. (Read it from your pack.)
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 2 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
A person, maybe 50s walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with sun-creased eyes walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 40s, with grey-streaked hair walks away from Haven. They don't look back.
A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You eat Dried meat (600 kcal).
Your chewing echoes off the trees. Something out there heard. (encounters more likely tomorrow)
A person, maybe 20s looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 20s shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💧 A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
A person, maybe 20s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
A person, maybe 20s picks through the bag, frowning. Nothing they can name with confidence. (8 ticks)
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms returns with water: +2 clean.

"Hey." A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
A person, maybe 50s came back with an armful of something edible, unprompted. (+100 kcal pantry)

A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic spends the afternoon with the thorny bush with dark berries — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Blackberry — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Blackberry. Thorny canes, dark berries. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 You see it again in your mind: a thorny bush with dark berries. A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic's words land on the memory like a label. Blackberry. Of course.
A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic was watching. Now they know Blackberry too.
🔍 A crouches over reed-like leaves; underground, knobby pale rhizomes, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
A woman, maybe 30s, with a burn-scarred forearm is hurt — a fall, a thorn, a bad step. (health 73/100)
You remember the Kitchen knife at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
You remember the Flannel Shirt at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
🤒 Victor is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse. You're already boiling water. It's handled.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, 2 unknown berries went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Blackberry — named and noted.
Arlo Cabrera reads the sky: clear tomorrow, cold.
A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 A man, maybe 40s, with a nervous tic — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 20s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 A person, maybe 50s — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin says. (Trust too low.)

A person, maybe 60s, with a gap-toothed grin mutters something under their breath. You catch only the last word: "again."
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
"Ella," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Ella." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Ella).
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Victor," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Victor." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Victor).
"Riley," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Riley." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Riley).
You eat Trail mix (800 kcal).
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.

⛓️ Thornfield doesn't say no. They say: "They'll take Haven — but the tribute is 6,000 kcal/week, not 5,000. Take it or leave it." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
A person, maybe 20s shrugs. "Name what? We haven't seen anything worth naming lately."
You open "The Night Shift Notebook". Written by headlamp on night shifts. 'The dark is busy. You're just not invited to the schedule meeting.'
🐾 Learned: Great Horned Owl (Level 1).
🐾 Learned: Big Brown Bat (Level 1).
🐾 Learned: Nine-banded Armadillo (Level 1).
📖 LEARNED: Nocturnal Patterns (Level 2). Hushpuppies hunt in packs after dark. Highbeam Deer freeze in the black between trees — that shine is them aiming. Moths come to any light you make.
📚 This book taught you skills, not just facts. Jackpot.
It's barely dawn. The day is yours — sleep is for later.
You are full enough.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Ella looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
Equipped Kitchen knife (melee).
Equipped Flannel Shirt (torso).
